author: Riilo
body:
Application
Age: 14
Timezone: AEST
Do you have access to TeamSpeak?: Yes 
Do you have access to Skype? Yes
Do you have access to a recording software?: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?:
I have never been staff on a huge server I guess you could say, but I still have staff experience. I have been staff on mini servers that don't reach much more players than 20. 

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
My biggest weakness is that I probably swear a tad to much, which I guess could be counted as immaturity. Obviously, if I was staff I would slack down the swearing.

 My biggest strength is that I basically never get off the computer. Thus I will always be able to moderate, except when i'm at school or asleep. Pretty much I have no life, and just never leave my computer seat.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?:
To be honest I can't massively change it, but I can basically be apart of it and just cater for the Australian timezone, because I know that there are mods lacking that timezone.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
A leader needs to have maturity and to be able to listen and co-operate with others. I do not consider myself as a "leader", but that doesn't mean I can't work well with one. 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
Well I can work well with others, and handle situations. I don't really know how to put my attributes in words, so i'm sorry.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
I believe you should have maturity, activeness, an own opinion. Considering I just came back, I guess you can't say i'm active, but before I left, I was extremely active and I want to keep it that way. I also do have my own opinion. I ain't the maturest of people, but I have learnt something over the 8 months I was gone.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
Well, I can play everyday. Homework takes me about an hour and a half, but I can play pretty much 80% of the day on weekends.
I also am pretty much always on a talking service, so I'm good at communicating.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?: I would note down all the accounts he is ban evading on, record him hacking, and alert a Senior Mod about the situation. If they are not on, /freeze the hacker and just wait for a Sr Mod.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?: If the leader has asked the staff politely multiple times to please leave, and the staff doesn't, I would tell them off. If they don't listen to me I would get a higher ranked staff member to deal with the situation/.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?:  Well, knowledge from the past says that if they are appealing, and you have no evidence, they can an instant unban. I guess you could also check to see if anymore staff got evidence but if they don't I assume they just get unbanned. I'm not too sure about this question, but I believe they just get let off because there is no proof.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?: If the information is for staff members and staff members only, then it shouldn't be leaked no matter what. I would tell them to delete the picture in private messages.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?: I believe you should be able to state your opinion without being too harsh. Like if you can give them Cons on their decision then they could change there mind. If they keep saying no to you, just leave it at that and don't worry about it. 


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
Well, Avicus has always been my favourite server, so getting it would be pretty special.

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?:
I can't say Avicus was really enjoyable with credits, but the community was still enjoyable. When prestiges were released it made me more happy, because I could enjoy the community, my friends and the game. 


Do you speak any other languages than English?:
I know about 0.5% Spanish, 3% Chinese, 1.1% Indonesia, and thats basically it. Not really helpful.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?
Not really, I just hope I get accepted, or get an improvement message.
